# knows about

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:knowsAbout`](gmeow-knowsAbout.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/knowsAbout>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/cognition`](../../slices/cognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Second level of the knowledge spectrum: the agent knows facts about the subject and can describe it — familiarity, not yet working comprehension. The exactMatch anchor for [schema:knowsAbout.](https://schema.org/knowsAbout.) Entails [`gmeow:isAwareOf`](gmeow-isAwareOf.md); entailed by [`gmeow:understands`](gmeow-understands.md), [`gmeow:hasMastered`](gmeow-hasMastered.md) and [`gmeow:hasSkill`](gmeow-hasSkill.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:isAwareOf`](gmeow-isAwareOf.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:knowsAbout`](gmeow-knowsAbout.md) from [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when the agent knows facts about a subject and can describe it — familiarity beyond mere awareness — and as the [schema:knowsAbout](https://schema.org/knowsAbout) export anchor.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the agent genuinely comprehends and can apply the subject (use [`gmeow:understands`](gmeow-understands.md)) and avoid conflating descriptive familiarity with the 'can do' competence axis ([`gmeow:hasSkill`](gmeow-hasSkill.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:knowsAbout`](gmeow-knowsAbout.md) from the agent to the subject; it entails [`gmeow:isAwareOf`](gmeow-isAwareOf.md) automatically, and is itself entailed when a deeper level or a skill is asserted.

### Examples

- ex:lillith [`gmeow:knowsAbout`](gmeow-knowsAbout.md) ex:rdfSemantics.
